title: iPadOS 27 adds three features to make iPad more like the Mac - 9to5Mac
summary: And now, iPadOS 27 does this too. iPadOS 27 users will find the active app’s name right next to other status bar elements like the time and date. Last year Apple brought the menu bar to iPad for the first time.
